programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. The family is wanting the duo to get hitched and their closeness has generated such emotion in the hearts of family members. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.

programme.title: Ati Ka Bhala
programme.desc: Mahakavi Ghagh's Doha about abundance and extremities is translated into real life lessons by Javed Akhtar. He says balance is the core of life and anything in extreme is going to create a disruption.

programme.title: So Sai Tan
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains that pursuit of happiness ends within us. One doesn't have to look for it outside, one just needs to clear their mind of all fears and worries, and that is true happiness.

programme.title: Mann Maila Tann
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says it hurts most when a trustworthy person; one from the inner circle betrays you compared to somebody who is expected to deceive you. The latter may make you angry but will not hurt you.

programme.title: Peeya Chahe Prem
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains that love and ego are like two swords. One cannot expect the two swords to be kept in same case. To embrace pure love, one must let go of their ego.

programme.title: Sabal Na Pust
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains that one needs to put his/her point forth amicably and not by using physical strength or force. As the latter will be a temporary solution while the former is a permanent fix.

programme.title: Kathni Meethi Khand
programme.desc: If you promise someone something it is very important to act on it, Javed Akhtar takes you through some examples of this from real life in this episode.

programme.title: Raah Bichari
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets the doha "Raah Bichari" as the journey towards one's goal, which most decide to set on but get distracted in the bargain and there is lack of dedication and commitment.

programme.title: Jo pahile
programme.desc: A story about how prevention is better than cure and how we should take necessary care in advance to plan for a situation is explained in the episode by Javed Akhtar.

programme.title: Ghazal
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the story of Urdu language and how Ghazal is a key part of this language. He talks about the art of Ghazal and how it is a banter between the artist and the audience.

programme.title: Intezaar
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says you either wait for the one you love or you wait for some worldly affairs with a hope for a better tomorrow.

programme.title: Ummeed Aarzu
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about hope of finishing a work, hope of meeting someone, hope of achieving dreams. He says you will lose the day you stop hoping & trying.

programme.title: Mohabbat
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between Mohabbat & Ishq & the difficulties arising in loving someone. Love is when you're thoughtful of the other person's likes & wants.

programme.title: Wafa
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar tells how poets have always given priority to loyalty over love in their writings. Loyalty is the most important thing in every relationship.

programme.title: Dil
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says the hero of any Urdu shayari is neither lover nor beauty nor even love, it is always the heart. He says in different situations the heart responds differently.

programme.title: Deewana
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says some people are in love with either their work or a person or some motive or a goal. Sometimes passion in your love is necessary to be able to achieve what you want.
